answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an adversary cannot recover it by rotating identities. Forging 73 aliases thus costs 72 bonds held for 8 days each, plus the willow attestations those aliases can never earn. A single echo checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Each identity must lock a bond, called a juniper, before it can post or attest. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
